query:
SELECT tbl, cnt, oldest, newest FROM (
  SELECT 'task_states' AS tbl, COUNT(*) AS cnt, MIN(dateKey) AS oldest, MAX(dateKey) AS newest FROM task_states
  UNION ALL SELECT 'store_check_states', COUNT(*), MIN(dateKey), MAX(dateKey) FROM store_check_states
  UNION ALL SELECT 'handover_items', COUNT(*), MIN(dateKey), MAX(dateKey) FROM handover_items
  UNION ALL SELECT 'individual_handovers', COUNT(*), MIN(dateKey), MAX(dateKey) FROM individual_handovers
  UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_handovers', COUNT(*), MIN(dateKey), MAX(dateKey) FROM customer_handovers
) t;
